title: ADA LOW-RISE WAX BLACK FRINGE DENIM
description: Cut low on the hip, with a flared hem that falls over the shoe. Deer suede fringe follows the outer leg. Turquoise-colored stones sit against the waxed black denim.

front.alt: Front of the ADA jean on a model, showing black flared legs, side fringe, and turquoise-colored embellishments.

pockets.alt: Waist and pocket detail with silver hardware and curved stitched motifs.

fringe.alt: Deer suede fringe at the outer leg beside a turquoise-colored embellishment.

hem.alt: Lower legs of the waxed black flares falling over the shoes.
